hook_line: MICROSOFT OFFERS VOLUNTARY BUYOUTS TO 60,000 EMPLOYEES

hook_stat.sub: Employees offered voluntary buyouts across four countries

stats.label: Microsoft's full-time workforce as of June 30
Offer covers eligible staff at level 70 and below

diaspora_bullets: Offer covers Microsoft staff in India and Indian employees abroad
Eligibility depends on team participation and level, not nationality
news_summary: Microsoft is offering a Voluntary Exit Offer to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its 223,000-person workforce, in the United States, Canada, India and the United Kingdom.
payoff: Microsoft said the offer is not a sign that it needs fewer employees overall.
